_doc: Build classes and each fighter's declared build, for `npm run lineup` (art/CHARACTER_SCALE.md, Build classes). Optional headColors / feetColors (hex) override the scale gate's automatic head and shoe palettes (Scale gate (automatic)). bodyColors (hex) are the garment colours of the body sheet (npm run body, Body sheet (TOOL-036)): the shipped shades of the main garment, the one visible in almost every pose, derived from the packed palette by the rule in _bodyColors (re-derive after a repack moves the palette). sbr = shoulder band / standingPx, by the idle's hand style (guard = hands up in front of the chest; down = hands down or in the pockets); dr = deltoid-to-deltoid width by eye / standingPx (the gate measure, recorded in deltoidPx); mwrMin = the idle's max width / its height with hair. Fighters are listed in roster order. standingReference.cells (256 px game cells under art/, byte copies of the approved title-style neutral cells in public/art-review/title-style-pilot) is the upright pose the packer's automatic hit box finder measures its rising-strike rule against (a fist above the standing head), instead of the idle: the title-style idles are crouched combat stances (TOOL-037, art/SPEC.md Hitboxes and hurtboxes).

naruto._headColors: the hair yellow only: the automatic palette also took the headband cloth, plate and orange shades the jacket shares, which welded the head to the collar or to raised sleeves
naruto._bodyColors: the orange jumpsuit: HSL 15-30 deg (the hair is above 30), s > 0.7, 0.4 < l < 0.65 over the packed sheet colours

sasuke._headColors: his hair is drawn in outline and coat shades, so the automatic head palette (art/CHARACTER_SCALE.md Scale gate) misses most of it
sasuke._bodyColors: white shirt, purple rope and blue apron: (l > 0.86, s < 0.6) or (265-295 deg, s > 0.4, 0.45 < l < 0.75) or (215-228 deg, s > 0.45, 0.38 < l < 0.6) over the packed sheet colours

scaleReference.why: Approved title-style combat cell (byte copy of public/art-review/title-style-pilot/killua-combat_v01.png, sha256 d32d8f9f297e...), the idle's own stance. Against the working idle v05 the probe palette fits that idle's exact shades and maps the separately generated strips' shading partly off the hair: every strip read ~0.89 and this approved cell itself read 0.912. Against this cell the idle reads 1.058 (body 144-146 px tall vs the cell's 146 px) and most strips ~1.0. Adding the relaxed neutral cell makes the idle read 1.061 (drift), so the neutral is not part of the reference. Same thresholds; the idle is now gated too (2026-10-11, TOOL-033).

killua._bodyColors: the lavender sweater, not the darker purple shoes: HSL 255-290 deg, s > 0.45, 0.58 < l < 0.8 over the packed sheet colours

gojo._bodyColors: the navy uniform: HSL 222-245 deg, s > 0.2, 0.15 < l < 0.45 over the packed sheet colours
